responsibility: Defines the Moxie backend’s machine-constraint language for instruction selection and reload. This file declares the target-specific memory and immediate constraints used by moxie.md patterns—absolute addresses, base-plus-offset and register-indirect memory forms, plus zero, unsigned 8-bit, and negated 8-bit integer constants—so GCC can classify RTL operands against the addressing modes and literal encodings actually accepted by Moxie instructions.
